::: callout-tip
All of the zen-do commands used on this page can also be used from
[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv). Why use uv? Rather than first installing zen-do
and then using a command it in, you can use `uvx` to both install and use right
away. It handles correctly installing the tool in a way that your system needs.
To use `uvx` on zen-do, it might look like:

```bash {.filename="Terminal"}
uvx zen-do
```

To upgrade zen-do with uv, you can run:

```bash {.filename="Terminal"}
uv tool upgrade --all
```
:::
